chapter.verse: Mi khatpeuh in pawlpi sya nasep a ut leh nahoih a lunggulh hi, cih thugenna pen a muantaak thu ahi hi.
Tua ahih manin pawlpi sya cih pen a kawkbaanglo, zi khat bek a nei, lungsim a tei sinsen, ngaihsut thulam tawn, a zahtak-huai, zinleleng do a siam, thuhilh a siam,
zukham nam ahilo, mi zo-thawh lo-in a thudik, a kitawng thei nam ahilo, sum a deih lua nam ahilo, hiding hi.
A innkuan sung hoihtak a makaih thei, a tate zong vang etlawm nei kawm mahin a niamlutsak thei, hiding hi.
A hang pen mi khat in ama' innkuan makaihzia ding a theih keileh Pasian' pawlpi bangci kep theih ding ahi hiam?
Amah pen thu-um a kikhelcil hilo ding hi. Hi hileh kiphasak gawpin dawimangpa' tuahkhak ding gawtna nam tuakkha thei ding hi.
Tua banah minsiatna tuakkha lo-in dawimangpa' thangzak sung a awkkhak loh nadingin a pualam mite' thupitmuh khat hiding hi.
Tua mah bangin pawlpi upate zong gamtatzia a zahtak-huai, nam nihin thugen ahilo, lengtui a zongsang lo, thumaanlo sum a iplah lo, hiding hi.
Kitheihtawmna lungsim a siangtho tawh upna thusim thuthuk a lenkipte hiding uh hi.
Tua banah sittel thuak masa uh henla kawkbaanglo ahih uhleh bek pawlpi upa sem uh hen.
Tua mah bangin a zite uh zong gamtatzia a zahtak-huai, mi a gendai lo, lungsim a tei sinsen, na khempeuh ah a muanhuai, hiding uh hi.
Upate khat ciat zi khat bek nei-in a tate leh a innkuan uh hoihtak a makaihte hi uh hen.
A hang pen upa hoihtak a semte in milak ah minhoih ngah uh a, Khris Jesu' sunga om upna thu ah zong sunglam kimuanna lianpi nei pah uh hi.
Note' kiangah hong pai baih thei dingin kilamen ka hih hangin hih thute kong gelh veve hi.
Tua pen kong ziakaikhak zenzen leh a nungta Pasian' pawlpi, thumaan thutak ii a khuampi leh a nangpi ahi, Pasian' innkuan sungah bangci gamtat ding cih na theih nading uh ka cihna hi.

Tua hi a, biakna lungsim i cih pen thusim a thukpi ahihlam i vekpi-in i thukim hi: Amah pen cilesa tawh a hong kilaak, Kha in dik hi ci-in a pulak, vanmite' muh hi a, Gentile mite' kianga kitangko, leitung mite in umin a pom, minpha sunga kilato, ahi hi.
